meta.name: audit
meta.description: Audit an inherited engagement or implementation against its evidence. Use when taking over work or joining mid-project; distinguish verified facts from inherited claims.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接手半途的工作,分清哪些是已证实的事实、哪些只是听来的说法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手别人留下的项目或工作,需要核实哪些结论真正可信
copy.tagline_en: Sort verified facts from inherited claims when taking over someone else's work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited a project or engagement and must tell verified facts from claims

howto.what: 接手别人的项目或半成品时,Claude 会拿证据逐项核查,把已核实的事实与继承来的说法分开列出,并如实报告缺失的能力或没跑过的检查。
howto.when: 当你接手他人留下的工作、或中途加入某个项目时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则沿用它当前的脱敏数据包与范围,不重新走一遍初始化。

say.text: 我刚接手这个项目,帮我分一下哪些说法是已核实的,哪些只是继承来的。
say.note: 按证据区分已核实事实与继承说法。

say.text: 这个实现里还有哪些检查和部署状态没验证过?
say.note: 会如实标出未跑的检查与未知项。

say.text: 别重新问一遍,直接沿用 @fde 当前的脱敏数据包来做审计。
say.note: 复用现有数据包与范围,不重启流程。

howto.what_en: When you inherit a project or join mid-engagement, Claude audits the work against its evidence, separates verified facts from inherited claims, and honestly reports missing capabilities or checks that were never run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you take over someone else's work or join a project mid-way. If called by @fde, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: I just took over this project — which claims are verified vs. inherited?
say_en.note: Separates verified facts from inherited claims.

say_en.text: Which checks and deployment states in this implementation are still unverified?
say_en.note: Flags unrun checks and unknowns honestly.

say_en.text: Don't re-ask — just reuse @fde's current sanitized packet to run the audit.
say_en.note: Reuses the existing packet and scope.
